glossary.entries.board.body.0: The given parts on the left supply premises; the goal on the right is the proposition to prove. Each rule part takes the required proofs and yields a conclusion. A wire carries a proposition proved under its associated premises and assumptions.
glossary.entries.board.body.1: A part displays its current conclusion. When an input does not match, it reports what was required and what it received. Select “Check proof” when ready.
glossary.entries.board.title: proof board
